levels.title: Tank Guard
levels.description: Salvages 20% of your vac tank's contents upon accidental encounters with the slime sea or following other forms of health loss.

levels.title: Tank Guard II
levels.description: Salvages 40% of your vac tank's contents upon accidental encounters with the slime sea or following other forms of health loss.

levels.title: Tank Guard III
levels.description: Salvages 60% of your vac tank's contents upon accidental encounters with the slime sea or following other forms of health loss.

levels.title: Power Injector
levels.description: Streamlines the vac's power transfer, reducing the delay before energy regenerates to 2 seconds.

levels.title: Power Injector II
levels.description: Adds a self-cleaning function to the power injector that cleans up all the gunk you'd rather not think about, reducing the delay before energy regenerates to 1 second.

levels.title: Jetpack
levels.description: Keep your head in the clouds with this amazing, personal jetpack!

levels.title: Jetpack II
levels.description: Enhanced jetpack thrusters that consume 20% less energy but produce double the fun.

levels.title: Water Tank
levels.description: Adds a specialized vac tank that allows you to store fresh water.

levels.title: Heart Module
levels.description: Syncs with your body's own vital processes to enhance life systems, boosting health to 150. Plus, it's sparkly.

levels.title: Heart Module II
levels.description: A more advanced and even sparklier heart module that boosts health to 200.

levels.title: Heart Module III
levels.description: The latest in life system amplification and sparkliness technology boosts health to 250.

levels.title: Heart Module IV
levels.description: An experimental life system amplification device that boosts health to 300.

levels.title: Power Core
levels.description: Augments your vacpack with an almost-certainly-safe micro fusion generator that boosts energy to 150.

levels.title: Power Core II
levels.description: This enhanced micro generator boosts energy to 200; but more importantly, is even smaller.

levels.title: Power Core III
levels.description: The latest micro generator boosts personal energy to 250, but not high enough to give up coffee entirely.

levels.title: Power Core IV
levels.description: An impossibly advanced micro generator boosts personal energy to 275. There's no way this is still legal.

levels.title: Power Core V
levels.description: An advanced micro generator that blows past all prevously known limits of personal energy, pushing it to 300.

levels.title: Dash Boots
levels.description: These highly advanced and, frankly, fashion-forward boots reduce the energy consumption of sprinting.

levels.title: Dash Boots II
levels.description: Experimental footwear capable of reducing the cost of sprinting even further. It makes you think walking is for suckers.

levels.title: Tank Booster
levels.description: Improved nano-storage cell technology allows your vac tanks to hold 30 units of whatever you can vac up.

levels.title: Tank Booster II
levels.description: These enhanced nano-storage cells throw caution to the wind and allow you to cram 40 units into each vac tank.

levels.title: Tank Booster III
levels.description: More is better, but in this case, it's best. These premium nano-storage cells can hold 50 units in each vac tank.

levels.title: Tank Booster IV
levels.description: A cutting-edge vac tank using experimental nano-storage technology that allows you to hold 60 units per tank.

levels.title: Tank Booster V
levels.description: Pushing the limits of slime science, the nano-storage technology increases vac tank capacity to 70.

levels.title: Tank Booster VI
levels.description: Thanks to the latest scientific breakthroughs, the nano-storage technology of this booster allows you to hold 80 units per vac tank.

levels.title: Tank Booster VII
levels.description: New scientific developments, which definitely passed peer review, allow for a nano-storage upgrade that lets you hold 90 units per vac tank!

levels.title: Tank Booster VIII
levels.description: Slime Science does it again! The improved (and totally safe) nano-storage technology in this booster enables you to hold a whopping 100 units per vac tank!

levels.title: Resource Harvester
levels.description: Adds a resonator to the vac's suction mechanism that shakes loose science resources from nodes in the environment.

levels.title: Shadow Sureshot
levels.description: A special vacpack upgrade that hones in on shadow slime weakpoints (their shadiest areas!) and doubles the amount of shadow plorts they produce when hit.

levels.title: Drone Archive Key
levels.description: Utilizes Miles Tech decryption algorithms to unlock access to archived logs on Research Drones.

levels.title: Pulse Wave
levels.description: Adds a pulse wave emitter feature to your vacpack that pushes away slimes whenever you need some personal space.

levels.title: Regenerator
levels.description: A small software update that improves energy routing through the vac's conduits, increasing the rate of energy regeneration to 46 per second.

levels.title: Regenerator II
levels.description: Integrates a significantly more advanced routing algorithm to the energy conduit, increasing the rate of energy regeneration to 52 per second.

levels.title: Extra Tank
levels.description: Adds an extra general-purpose vac tank.

levels.title: Extra Tank II
levels.description: Adds yet another extra general-purpose vac tank.

levels.title: Golden Sureshot
levels.description: A special vacpack upgrade that hones in on gold slime weakpoints (their secret bellybutton?) and doubles the amount of gold plorts they produce when hit.

levels.title: Golden Sureshot II
levels.description: Upgrades the Sureshot's focusing lens, reducing the glare from those shiny, bright gold slimes. This triples the amount of gold plorts they produce when hit.

levels.title: Golden Sureshot III
levels.description: Installs a new targeting sensor to drastically increase the Sureshot's accuracy, quadrupling the number of plorts produced by gold slimes when they are hit.

plotUpgrades.title: Improved Storage Capacity
plotUpgrades.description: Each silo slot can now hold up to 200 items.

plotUpgrades.title: Plort Collector
plotUpgrades.description: A plort collector will vacuum up one type of plort in an incinerator at regular intervals, depositing them into a storage tank, so long as space is available.

plotUpgrades.title: Plort Collector
plotUpgrades.description: A plort collector will vacuum up one type of plort in a pond at regular intervals, depositing them into a storage tank, so long as space is available.

plotUpgrades.title: Additional Storage
plotUpgrades.description: A silo can have up to four ports for storing plorts and resources.

plotUpgrades.title: High Walls
plotUpgrades.description: Helps prevent chickens from flying the coop.

plotUpgrades.title: Spring Grass
plotUpgrades.description: Spring grass attracts scuttle bugs that chickens just love to eat. With their bellies full, chickens will grow into healthy hens and roostros twice as fast.

plotUpgrades.title: Growth Amplifier
plotUpgrades.description: Tweaks the garden's replicator to produce a bigger harvest than normally possible.

plotUpgrades.title: Elder Collector
plotUpgrades.description: Safely and gently moves Elder chickens away from the younger generation and stores them in a collector.

plotUpgrades.title: Plort Collector
plotUpgrades.description: A plort collector will vacuum up two types of plorts in a corral at regular intervals, depositing them into a storage tank, so long as space is available.

plotUpgrades.title: Nutrient Soil
plotUpgrades.description: Nutrient soil contains compost from the Rainbow Fields and minerals from Ember Valley. Makes crops always yield the maximum harvest.

plotUpgrades.title: Additional Storage
plotUpgrades.description: A silo can have up to four ports for storing plorts and resources.

plotUpgrades.title: Music Box
plotUpgrades.description: The music box plays a soothing tune that greatly reduces slime agitation.

plotUpgrades.title: Air Net
plotUpgrades.description: An air net is a force barrier that covers the top of a corral. It can take a few hits before needing to recharge.

plotUpgrades.title: High Walls
plotUpgrades.description: Higher corral walls ensure that even the bounciest of slimes will have difficulty escaping.

plotUpgrades.title: Scareslime
plotUpgrades.description: A scareslime is a stuffed tarr model designed to keep wandering slimes away from your crops. Simple, but terrifying.

plotUpgrades.title: Ash Trough
plotUpgrades.description: An ash trough allows you to collect the ash of incinerated food at its base, which is eaten exclusively by fire slimes. It's gross.

plotUpgrades.title: Solar Shield
plotUpgrades.description: A solar shield will encase a corral in a dim shade, protecting slimes sensitive to light.

plotUpgrades.title: Sprinkler
plotUpgrades.description: A sprinkler ensures that your crops are always watered, making them grow twice as fast.

plotUpgrades.title: Miracle Mix
plotUpgrades.description: This special mix greatly increases the time it takes for ripe fruits and veggies to rot, so long as they are touching the garden's soil.

plotUpgrades.title: Auto-Feeder
plotUpgrades.description: An auto-feeder will drop food into the corral at regular intervals. Just remember to keep it stocked!

plotUpgrades.title: Additional Storage
plotUpgrades.description: A silo can have up to four ports for storing plorts and resources.

plotUpgrades.title: Vitamizer
plotUpgrades.description: The very latest in advanced poultry tech, the vitamizer bathes the hens in 'vita-rays,' allowing them to produce eggs twice as fast.
